source: Original fictional game content. Scenarios are framed by public reporting and analysis of each flashpoint as of November 2026 (CSIS ChinaPower and Joint Exercise analyses of a Taiwan quarantine; 2010 Yeonpyeong shelling; NATO Article 4 consultations; 2019 and 2023 Hormuz tanker seizures; the 2019 and 2025 India–Pakistan crises; the Lomonosov Ridge claims before the UN Commission on the Limits of the Continental Shelf).
notes: Multi-step event chains (D-074). Each chain has an entry event (drawn when its conditions hold; weight = % chance per month) and follow-up steps scheduled by 'chain' effects. 'actor' lists who decides a step: the player if listed, else the first living nation; AI actors choose by 'stance' weighted by their traits. Every chain is acyclic and every step has a choice that ends it (tested).

chains.name: Taiwan: from quarantine to the brink

events.title: Customs quarantine of Taiwan
events.text: Beijing's planners present a 'law-enforcement' option: coast-guard inspections of every ship bound for Taiwan's ports, framed as customs control rather than a blockade. The PLA Eastern Theatre Command would stand behind the cutters.

choices.label: Signal with exercises only
choices.tooltip: Tension rises a little; nothing is enforced and the crisis ends here.

choices.label: Declare the customs quarantine
choices.tooltip: Sharp escalation: Taipei, Washington and Tokyo must answer. Trade with Taiwan is disrupted.

effects.text: China announces coast-guard 'customs quarantine' around Taiwan

choices.label: Shelve the plan
choices.tooltip: The crisis is defused; hardliners grumble.

events.title: The quarantine bites
events.text: Chinese coast-guard cutters are boarding Taiwan-bound freighters. Insurers have suspended cover; LNG cargoes are diverting. Allies must decide how to respond.

choices.label: Protest and sanction, no escorts
choices.tooltip: Sanctions on China; Taiwan's energy stocks start to fall.

choices.label: Escort convoys through the strait
choices.tooltip: US and Japanese warships shepherd merchant ships past the cutters. Risk of an incident at sea.

effects.text: US destroyers begin escorting convoys to Taiwan

choices.label: Quiet diplomacy through back channels
choices.tooltip: Beijing scales the inspections back to a token level; Taipei feels abandoned. The crisis ends here.

events.title: Incident at sea
events.text: A Chinese coast-guard cutter collides with an escorted freighter at night; warning shots are fired across the bow of an American destroyer. Both navies are on hair-trigger alert.

choices.label: Hold the line and add patrols
choices.tooltip: Neither side blinks; the crisis moves toward its climax.

choices.label: Seize the freighter
choices.tooltip: A direct challenge to the escort mission.

choices.label: Use the military hotline; both sides pull back
choices.tooltip: The incident is contained; the quarantine is quietly relaxed.

events.title: Taiwan's energy squeeze
events.text: With LNG stocks for little more than a week, Taipei must choose between rationing, talks with Beijing or an appeal for an allied airlift.

choices.label: Ration energy and hold out
choices.tooltip: Hardship at home, but the quarantine fails to break the island.

choices.label: Appeal for an allied airlift
choices.tooltip: Washington and Tokyo are pulled in; Beijing sees provocation.

choices.label: Open talks with Beijing
choices.tooltip: The quarantine is lifted; Taiwan's partners worry about the precedent.

events.title: Crisis in the Taiwan Strait
events.text: The quarantine has become a naval standoff. The Central Military Commission meets in emergency session: stand down, mobilise and issue an ultimatum, or open fire.

choices.label: Mobilise and issue an ultimatum
choices.tooltip: DEFCON rises on both sides of the Pacific; the world waits.

effects.text: Beijing issues ultimatum to Taipei as PLA mobilises

choices.label: Open fire: invade Taiwan
choices.tooltip: War. The United States and Japan may enter.

choices.label: Accept a UN-brokered stand-down
choices.tooltip: The crisis ends; nationalist anger at home.

chains.name: Korea: nuclear test to border shelling

events.title: Seventh nuclear test
events.text: Satellite imagery shows tunnelling complete at Punggye-ri. Pyongyang can conduct its first nuclear test since 2017, settle for missile launches, or trade restraint for relief.

choices.label: Fire missiles into the sea instead
choices.tooltip: A familiar provocation; Seoul and Tokyo must respond.

choices.label: Conduct the nuclear test
choices.tooltip: Sanctions and outrage; the crisis escalates.

choices.label: Postpone the test and seek aid talks
choices.tooltip: Tension eases; hardliners in Pyongyang are displeased.

events.title: Seoul weighs its response
events.text: After Pyongyang's latest provocation, South Korea and its allies must choose between deterrence, sanctions and dialogue.

choices.label: Push new UN sanctions
choices.tooltip: Pressure without military risk.

choices.label: Deploy strategic assets and expand exercises
choices.tooltip: Bombers and a carrier visit; Pyongyang vows retaliation.

choices.label: Offer talks at Panmunjom
choices.tooltip: A gamble on diplomacy; hawks object.

events.title: Shells on a border island
events.text: Korean People's Army artillery shells a South Korean island near the Northern Limit Line. Marines are wounded; homes burn.

choices.label: Claim it was a drill gone wrong
choices.tooltip: Tension stays high, but the crisis ends.

choices.label: Shell again and declare a new maritime border
choices.tooltip: Seoul must answer force with force.

choices.label: Express regret through the hotline
choices.tooltip: Unusual restraint from Pyongyang.

events.title: Retaliate across the NLL?
events.text: South Korea's rules of engagement allow a proportional response. The Joint Chiefs ask for authority to go further.

choices.label: Counter-battery fire only
choices.tooltip: A proportional answer; the exchange stops.

choices.label: Strike KPA artillery positions in depth
choices.tooltip: Likely war on the peninsula.

effects.text: South Korea strikes North Korean artillery; war erupts on the peninsula

choices.label: Raise readiness and wait
choices.tooltip: DEFCON rises; forces surge to the DMZ.

chains.name: Baltic: little green men in Narva

events.title: Hybrid operation in Narva
events.text: Russian military intelligence proposes backing a 'self-defence committee' among Russian speakers in Narva, with unmarked operatives, cyber attacks and a disinformation campaign.

choices.label: Cyber and information operations only
choices.tooltip: A test of NATO's nerves below the threshold of force.

choices.label: Back the 'self-defence committee'
choices.tooltip: Armed men without insignia seize the town hall; NATO must respond.

effects.text: Armed men without insignia seize Narva town hall

choices.label: Stand the operation down
choices.tooltip: Nothing happens — this time.

events.title: NATO consultations under Article 4
events.text: Estonia requests consultations. Allies must choose between a show of force, police action and quiet talks with Moscow.

choices.label: Police operation and expulsions
choices.tooltip: Estonian police clear the town hall; Russian diplomats are expelled.

choices.label: Invoke Article 4 and surge NATO forces
choices.tooltip: Battlegroups reinforce Narva; Moscow sees encirclement.

choices.label: Quiet talks with Moscow
choices.tooltip: The operatives melt away; Tallinn feels exposed.

events.title: NATO reinforces Narva
events.text: With allied battlegroups on the Narva river, the Kremlin weighs its next move.

choices.label: Snap exercise in Pskov
choices.tooltip: Russian forces mass on the border.

choices.label: Seize the border bridge
choices.tooltip: War with a NATO member — Article 5.

choices.label: Withdraw the operatives
choices.tooltip: The crisis ends with a Russian climb-down.

events.title: Russian forces on the border
events.text: A Russian snap exercise has massed armour opposite Estonia and Latvia. Allied capitals debate how hard to push back.

choices.label: Reinforce and wait
choices.tooltip: More allied troops; no ultimatum.

choices.label: Issue an ultimatum: withdraw within 48 hours
choices.tooltip: DEFCON rises across the alliance.

choices.label: Open a deconfliction line
choices.tooltip: The exercise ends; both sides claim victory.

events.title: Tanker seized in Hormuz
events.text: IRGC naval forces seize a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz. Tehran calls it a smuggling case; Gulf capitals call it piracy.

choices.label: Hold the tanker as leverage
choices.tooltip: Shipping insurers raise premiums; the Gulf states must decide.

choices.label: Seize more tankers and mine the approaches
choices.tooltip: Shipping through Hormuz stops.

effects.text: Mines reported in the Strait of Hormuz; tanker traffic halts

choices.label: Release the tanker
choices.tooltip: Tension eases.

events.title: Escort the tankers?
events.text: Washington and the Gulf states debate a convoy operation through the strait.

choices.label: Pay the release quietly
choices.tooltip: The ship goes free; Tehran learns it pays.

choices.label: Launch an escort operation
choices.tooltip: Warships shepherd tankers past IRGC fast boats.

choices.label: Mediation through Oman
choices.tooltip: A face-saving release.

events.title: Mines in the strait
events.text: A fifth of the world's oil passes through Hormuz — and now it does not. Importers clamour for action.

choices.label: Mine-clearing operation under escort
choices.tooltip: Slow, expensive and risky.

choices.label: Strike IRGC naval bases
choices.tooltip: War with Iran.

effects.text: US strikes Iranian naval bases after Hormuz mining

choices.label: Negotiate through Qatar
choices.tooltip: Iran clears its own mines in exchange for concessions.

events.title: Fast boats swarm a destroyer
events.text: Dozens of IRGC fast attack craft surround a coalition destroyer escorting tankers. The captain requests permission to fire.

choices.label: Harass but do not fire
choices.tooltip: The boats veer off at the last moment.

choices.label: Attack the escort
choices.tooltip: War with the escorting powers.

effects.text: Iranian boats attack US destroyer in the Gulf

choices.label: Order the boats back
choices.tooltip: The convoy passes.

events.title: Massacre in Kashmir
events.text: Militants kill dozens of civilians in Jammu and Kashmir. Indian intelligence traces the attackers to a group based in Pakistan. The public demands a response.

choices.label: Suspend water cooperation and expel diplomats
choices.tooltip: Coercion short of force.

choices.label: Cross-border strikes on militant camps
choices.tooltip: Pakistan will answer.

effects.text: India strikes militant camps across the Line of Control

choices.label: Offer a joint investigation
choices.tooltip: Restraint; hardliners protest.

events.title: Pakistan answers the strikes
events.text: Pakistan's army and government weigh their response to Indian strikes on their territory.

choices.label: Shoot down intruders and declare victory
choices.tooltip: Honour satisfied; the crisis subsides.

choices.label: Retaliatory air and missile strikes
choices.tooltip: Two nuclear powers exchange fire.

choices.label: Accept Saudi and US mediation
choices.tooltip: A ceasefire understanding.

events.title: Water and diplomatic squeeze
events.text: India's suspension of water cooperation and expulsions put Islamabad under pressure.

choices.label: Take it to the UN
choices.tooltip: Diplomatic counter-offensive.

choices.label: Mobilise along the Line of Control
choices.tooltip: Troops move; the crisis escalates.

choices.label: Crack down on the militant group
choices.tooltip: Arrests at home; tension eases.

events.title: Two nuclear powers on the brink
events.text: After an exchange of strikes, Indian commanders propose naval pressure on Karachi or a limited ground offensive.

choices.label: Naval pressure on Karachi
choices.tooltip: Coercion at sea.

choices.label: Limited ground offensive across the LoC
choices.tooltip: War between nuclear-armed neighbours.

effects.text: India launches ground offensive across the Line of Control

choices.label: Agree a hotline ceasefire
choices.tooltip: The guns fall silent.

chains.name: Arctic: the race for the seabed

events.title: Lomonosov Ridge claim
events.text: With sea ice retreating, Moscow can press its continental-shelf claim along the Lomonosov Ridge with Northern Fleet escorts for its survey ships.

choices.label: Militarise the Northern Sea Route
choices.tooltip: New bases and air-defence batteries along the route.

choices.label: Declare an extended economic zone
choices.tooltip: A unilateral claim; Norway and Denmark protest.

choices.label: Submit the claim to the UN commission
choices.tooltip: The lawful route; slow.

events.title: Survey ship off Svalbard
events.text: A Russian survey ship escorted by a frigate operates inside Norway's claimed zone off Svalbard.

choices.label: Diplomatic protest
choices.tooltip: Lawfare, not warships.

choices.label: Shadow it with NATO frigates
choices.tooltip: A naval standoff in the Barents Sea.

choices.label: Offer joint seabed research
choices.tooltip: Cooperation instead of confrontation.

events.title: Frigate standoff in the Barents
events.text: Russian and NATO warships manoeuvre within a few hundred metres of each other around the survey ship.

choices.label: Snap Northern Fleet exercise
choices.tooltip: Show of force; the standoff ends.

choices.label: Board the Norwegian research vessel
choices.tooltip: A direct challenge to a NATO member.

choices.label: Withdraw the survey ship
choices.tooltip: The crisis ends.

events.title: Boarding crisis in the high north
events.text: Russian marines have boarded a Norwegian research vessel. Oslo asks its allies for support.

choices.label: Sanctions on Arctic LNG
choices.tooltip: Economic pressure.

choices.label: Invoke Article 4 and deploy a carrier group
choices.tooltip: Escalation at sea.

choices.label: Negotiate the crew's release
choices.tooltip: Quiet diplomacy.
